title: Microbiome, GvHD, and immune reconstitution in allogeneic hematopoietic cell transplantation

items.quote: the administration of butyrate or butyrate producing bacteria mitigated GvHD severity and improved transplant outcome in murine GvHD

items.quote: preservation of butyrate-producing bacterial. In particular fecal butyrate concentration after alloHCT was maintained or even increased in the prebiotics group. This translated in a clinical benefit with a significantly lower cumulative incidence of gastro-intestinal grade II-IV GvHD

fields.evidence_as_stated: prospective trial, 49 patients and 142 matched historic controls
fields.mechanism_as_named: Preserved butyrate producers lower GI grade II-IV GVHD

items.note: Prebiotic (RS + GFO) preserves butyrate producers -> lower GI grade II-IV GvHD (and reduced skin aGVHD, next sentence). Target is the functional group the diet acts on (MOS_028 pattern).

items.quote: In all studies stools from responding patients demonstrated higher microbiota richness and increased levels of beneficial bacteria, in particular butyrate producers

items.note: Uncited cross-study summary of FMT for GI-aGVHD [75-79]; rises in responders -> protective (GUO_038 pattern). Reviewer may assign the FMT study refs or reject.

items.note: No explicit GVHD outcome; 'intestinal inflammation and outcome' is generic. Lactobacillus in an early transplant model.
